what: STRATEGY SEARCH FOR FASTER PROP PASSES (operator, 2026-10-06 ~07:15Z, verbatim: "continue searching for new strategies (in general, but specifically for the prop accounts), with an emphasis on shorter-timeframe strategies, or at least strategies that turn a profit faster (we would ideally want +10% monthly, not over more than 6 months)"). Start AFTER the weekly usage reset (Wed 2026-10-07 18:00Z). CONTEXT (MEASURED): every current prop roster is ETH+SOL trend_donchian 1h at 0.5% risk; velotrade_1 sim RQ-20261006-002 has median ~220d to +10% (P(pass in 730d) ~0.62) and P(net>0) ~0.46 -- pace, not risk, is the binding constraint, and 1.5% risk breaks the daily-loss line. TARGET: a prop book that reaches +10% in ~30d median (hard ceiling 6 months) WITHOUT breaching the daily-loss / static-DD rules of tradeify_247_1step, breakout_turbo_1step and velotrade_classic_1step. SCOPE: (1) shorter timeframes (5m/15m/1h) on prop-eligible symbols (Breakout list https://www.breakoutprop.com/symbols/, Tradeify, Velotrade instruments); (2) higher-frequency or higher-expectancy legs that diversify the ETH/SOL trend book (low daily-PnL correlation); (3) book construction: more uncorrelated legs at the same per-trade risk so pace rises without daily-loss breach. METHOD: register each rule BEFORE the run (research/queue unit + RULE id), full cost stack per venue, prop ruleset sim with median-days-to-target and P(pass by 30/90/180d) as headline metrics alongside the existing risk gates. Feeds research/THEMES.yaml new_strategy_prop (weight 6). DONE = a ranked candidate list with registered verdicts and, for any leg/book that clears, the exact proposed accounts.yaml diff for the manager's Tier-3 call.
